svg.aria-label: End-to-end product engineering: Requirements, UX/UI, full-stack code, automated deployment. German and English: A visit sets no cookie, so the site needs no consent banner. Three live demos: A CRM dashboard, an MCP demo and an arcade shooter in WASM. One private admin: A private area at /admin: contact inbox, cookieless traffic KPIs and a Magic: The Gathering collection
